name: Agag
description: King living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness

points: His king shall be higher than Agag: Agag was a tall Edomite. There will be no question in the kingdom which one is the Son of God; it is going to be astronomically clear. He shall eat up the nations his enemies: Balaam saw Christ destroying the nations. Blessed is he that blesseth thee, and cursed is he that curseth thee.
His seed shall be in many waters means Israel scattered all over the earth, and his kingdom shall be exalted higher than Agag.

note.label: Numbers 24: A Star out of Jacob and the Latter Days
